text: あたし　ニドラン　すき　だから　たくさん　あつめてるの

structure.jp: あたし　ニドラン　すき　だから
たくさん　あつめてるの

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から gives the reason for what follows: 'so'. すき だから = 'because I like them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says it is going on; here it is shortened to てる as in casual speech. あつめてる = 'am collecting'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end gently explains something about oneself, often in girls' speech. あつめてるの = 'I'm collecting them, you see'.
